WITH trans_sentiment AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_shortintrt,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
ordertypedist_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(avg_shortintrt) as ordertype_avg_shortintrt
  FROM trans_sentiment
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  ts.transreg,
  ts.ordertypedist,
  ts.avg_shortintrt,
  ts.avg_optvolrt,
  CASE 
    WHEN ota.ordertype_avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL AND ota.ordertype_avg_shortintrt > 0
    THEN ts.avg_shortintrt / ota.ordertype_avg_shortintrt
    ELSE NULL
  END as shortintrt_ratio
FROM trans_sentiment ts
LEFT JOIN ordertypedist_avg ota ON ts.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist
ORDER BY 
  shortintrt_ratio IS NULL,
  shortintrt_ratio DESC
